name: Fireflies.ai
description: Fireflies.ai records and transcribes meetings and audio files, and its paid plans add integrations, analytics and team features.
features: Zapier and app integrations on higher tiers
useCases: Searching what was said in past calls
strengths: The FAQ says there are no monthly rate limits on the meeting bot or Chrome extension
limitations: Prices and Free-plan limits were not readable on the page we fetched
Some features (API, dialers, bulk uploads) have rate limits

free.details: Free forever: unlimited transcription, limited AI summaries, 400 minutes of storage per team, 20 AI credits.

plans.name: Pro
plans.note: $10 per seat per month billed annually. A higher figure of $18 is shown beside it; the monthly view was not captured.

plans.name: Business
plans.note: $19 per seat per month billed annually. A higher figure of $29 is shown beside it; the monthly view was not captured.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: $39 per seat per month, annual billing only; contact sales.

pricing.regional: Currency and regional pricing: not stated in the text we could read. Check the official page for current prices.
notes: The official page said paid plans are charged per seat and to contact the company for more than 50 members.

verification.notes: Product active. Page opened with a Monthly/Annual toggle (save up to 44%). Billed annually per seat/month: Pro $10, Business $19, Enterprise $39 (annual only). A second, higher figure sits beside Pro ($18) and Business ($29) and is most likely the monthly-billing price, but the Monthly view could not be toggled so it is not recorded as a price. Corrected: plan prices and Free limits were previously missing.
